annotations.title: Solana token info: supply, decimals, mint and freeze authority

description: Look up a Solana SPL token by its mint address, live from mainnet: decimals, total supply, whether a mint authority can still create more and whether a freeze authority can freeze holders (two common rug-pull risks), the token program, and, on request, the largest holder accounts with their share of supply. Use before buying or accepting an unknown Solana token. A mint that does not exist is 404, uncharged. Example: mint=EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

holders.description: Largest holder accounts to list, 0-20 (default 0; best effort, the public node rate-limits this lookup)
